messages:
ben.support: Heads-up: customer FastForm is seeing a spike in 502/504 + client timeouts against hosted inference (us-west) since ~03:12 UTC. p50 latency jumped from 120ms -> 1.8s and p95 -> 6s. Customers reporting retries and duplicate billing. Logs attached.
ben.support: log snippet: 
```
2026-03-18T03:12:07Z ERROR gateway request_id=abc123 upstream=hosted-inference us-west status=502 backend=runtime-arn-xyz latency_ms=1850
2026-03-18T03:12:12Z WARN  proxy request_id=abc124 upstream=hosted-inference queue_ms=900 backend=kvcache miss
```
ben.support: repro curl (customer):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"model": "redwood-large", "input": "long prompt..."}' -v
```
carla.eng: Thanks — any deploys around 03:00-03:10?
dani.oncall: Canary routing tweak went out 03:05 (commit 3f1b9d) to route 20% traffic to new edge pool in us-west. infra-bot: deploy canary/edge-route 3f1b9d -> success.
alice.sre: On-call looking. Check gateway circuit-breaker counts and connection pool saturation. Also check worker queue depth and batching.
emily-ps: Metrics: backend concurrency per-host hit 128 -> 1024 queued requests, average worker latency rose. KV cache miss rate doubled. Graphs: /d/infra/hosted-inference/us-west.
carla.eng: KV misses + routing to new edge pool could explain sudden backend load. The new edge pool has slightly different kernel/quantization variant — may increase per-token time.
dani.oncall: Suggest immediate rollback of the routing tweak to 100% baseline. Also enable fallback to smaller model (redwood-medium) for customers with >5s latency to reduce load.
alice.sre: Agreed. Action: (1) rollback canary routing (dani) (2) temp fallback config per customer (carla) (3) increase gateway circuit-breaker threshold by 20% while we stabilize (alice)
dani.oncall: Rolling back now -> infra-bot: action=rollback canary/edge-route commit=3f1b9d -> started.
carla.eng: Patching fallback: add per-customer policy for FastForm to prefer redwood-medium for requests >2k tokens. Patch applied to config service, propagating.
infra-bot: rollback canary/edge-route commit=3f1b9d -> success at 03:30 UTC.
ben.support: Post-rollback: error rate dropped back to baseline within 3m. Customer confirmed lower error surface.
alice.sre: Good. Collecting artifacts for postmortem: logs from 03:00-03:40, KVS metrics, deploy audit, canary config diff, per-host latency traces. emily, can you export?
emily-ps: Exported: s3://redwood-incident-archive/8599999999/ (logs, graphs, traces). Uploaded.
carla.eng: Root cause hypothesis: routing change directed nontrivial traffic fraction to edge pool with slower per-token performance under long prompts, causing backend queueing -> kvcache pressure -> gateway circuit breakers tripped -> 502/504 for inflight requests.
dani.oncall: Repro steps I ran: 1) route 20% to edge-pool B 2) send sustained long prompts (>=2k tokens) at 20r/s 3) observe worker latency climb then queue growth -> gateway 502s. Cmd I used: 
```bash
ab -n 2000 -c 20 -p long_prompt.json -T application/json https://canary-edge.us-west.redwood/v1/generate
```
alice.sre: Immediate mitigation done. Next: postmortem & action items. Proposed action items: 
- A1: Add per-edge performance profile and include perf delta gating for routing rollouts (owner: carla.eng, due 2026-03-25)
- A2: Automated canary load test (synthetic long prompt) before routing traffic >10% (owner: dani.oncall, due 2026-03-22)
- A3: Improve KV cache warmup / fallback logic to avoid cold-miss storms during pool changes (owner: emily-ps, due 2026-03-30)
- A4: Update customer-facing retry guidance to avoid duplicate billing on 502/504 transient (owner: ben.support, due 2026-03-21)
- A5: Add alert that combines p95 latency increase + kv-miss-rate delta to trigger preemptive rollback (owner: alice.sre, due 2026-03-20)
carla.eng: I'll also add a post-deploy signoff checklist for edge variant perf numbers and a perf smoke job in CI.
ben.support: I'll coordinate customer comms. Draft: "we mitigated routing issue by rolling back canary and applied a temporary fallback for your workspace; full follow-up and credits tomorrow". Any objections?
dani.oncall: No objections. Send and CC engineering lead.
alice.sre: Closing war room. We'll open a postmortem doc and assign owners. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: incident 8599999999 closed by alice.sre at 03:40 UTC.
